title: Eaternity BAFU-extension elementary flows → EF 3.1 characterization flow keys
description: Provisional datasource: Eaternity's extension of their BAFU-2026-based instance (sub-compartments collapsed, extension substances beyond official BAFU-2026). Entries derived from the Eaternity contributions in PR #5 (fork commit 4cf9cf5: 1,210 soil pairs) and PR #6 (fork commit e12f8a9: 18,065 regionalized land-use pairs, flow x ISO), keeping Eaternity's native source codes. To be re-pinned against Eaternity's published, versioned flow list when it ships.
